source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten Co. Armagh divisions, two councillors each), polled 31 May 1911: contests in Kernan, Lurgan Rural and Portadown Rural. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Campbell an old member and O'Neill a former member. John Conway was also nominated (Lurgan Mail, 6 May 1911, p. 5) but there was no poll: "Polling also took place in three divisions in Lurgan rural district" (Lurgan Mail, 3 June 1911, p. 5).
